info.title: XChain Hub API
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 API (POST /) of the XChain hub: config oracle, price oracle, cross-chain coordinator, and validator-federation surface. Public deployment is path-routed per chain: https://hub.xchain.io/{COIN}/. Read methods are open; methods marked with x-auth require an x-api-key header when the operator has configured HUB_API_KEY. Methods marked x-internal are service-to-service (indexers/validators); general clients should not call them. Errors follow JSON-RPC 2.0 ({code, message}); registry: https://docs.xchain.io/protocol/Error_Codes.md. LLM-friendly docs: https://docs.xchain.io/llms.txt

methods.name: ping
methods.summary: Health check.

schema.description: status is "degraded", with HTTP 503, when the DB probe fails or times out.

methods.name: health
methods.summary: Detailed health: DB, oracle staleness, P2P state (503 when degraded).

methods.name: getallconfigs
methods.summary: Service discovery: connection parameters for every platform service on this chain (mesh-internal, keyed like a write). Secret-bearing params (rpc/DB passwords) are REDACTED to the literal "[redacted]" unless include_secrets is set, which needs HUB_CONFIG_SECRETS_API_KEY when the hub configures one and the bulk key otherwise; the response reports secrets_redacted and redacted_params. since_updated_at returns only entries changed after that timestamp.
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: updateconfig
methods.summary: Update a service config entry (PBFT-replicated in validator mode).
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: getoraclesubmissions
methods.summary: Raw per-validator oracle price submissions for recent rounds, plus round cadence, skipped/dropped-pair diagnostics and oracleMaxPriceAgeSeconds (the price-age bound getprice enforces). Carries active:true; a hub that runs no oracle round (standalone config-oracle deployment, no P2P_VALIDATOR_ADDR) answers {active:false} rather than an error, so a health consumer can tell an absent role from a failure.

methods.name: getpricesnapshots
methods.summary: PBFT-finalized price snapshots (trimmed-median rounds). status='all' also returns skipped/disputed rows; with_watermark wraps the rows as {watermark, oracleMaxPriceAgeSeconds, snapshots} with a hub-clock epoch-seconds watermark and the price-age bound getprice enforces.

oneOf.description: Returned when with_watermark is truthy: hub-clock epoch seconds, the price-age bound getprice enforces (oracleMaxPriceAgeSeconds, null when the registry read fails), plus the rows.
In-result error envelope: this handler validates arguments itself and returns {error} rather than raising a JSON-RPC error.

methods.name: getoracleroundpresence
methods.summary: Per-round oracle PRESENCE over a range: for every round in [from_round, to_round], whether this hub recorded it at all and how it ended (finalized / skipped / disputed / missing), plus the explicit `missing` list and a `digest` over the (round, status) sequence. Poll several hubs over the same range and compare digests to detect federation divergence about which rounds happened. Omitted bounds anchor on this hub's highest recorded round and the last `limit` rounds (default 50, max 1000).

methods.name: getprice
methods.summary: Latest finalized price for a pair (e.g. BTC/USD).

methods.name: getfeequote
methods.summary: Protocol fee quote for an action (native-coin USD-pegged fees).

methods.name: getcapabilitythresholds

methods.name: rotatevalidator

methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: deregistervalidator

methods.name: syncvalidators
methods.summary: Sync the validator set from a peer.
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: getvalidators
methods.summary: Known validators and their status.

methods.name: getvalidatorstatus
methods.summary: Status of one validator, by signing key.

methods.name: getattestationstats
methods.summary: Attestation throughput counters per validator.

methods.name: getcrosschaincallstats
methods.summary: Cross-chain call relay backlog depth and lifetime failure counters.

methods.name: getcrosschaincall
methods.summary: One XCALL relay lifecycle by call_id: {call_id, dispatch, result} (both phases from the hub's cross_chain_calls table).

methods.name: getxcall
methods.summary: One XCALL relay lifecycle by call_id (shorter alias of getcrosschaincall).

methods.name: listxcall
methods.summary: List XCALL relay rows, newest first, with optional source_chain/target_chain/status/phase filters.

methods.name: getcheckpointstats
methods.summary: State-checkpoint health: last finalized block per chain and quorum-timeout counters.

methods.name: anchorflush
methods.summary: Trigger an immediate ANCHOR checkpoint publish (election still applies).
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: getanchorstatus
methods.summary: ANCHOR publisher status: cumulative publish counts plus the last-observed DOGE publisher wallet balance and low-balance threshold.

methods.name: getrollcallstatus
methods.summary: ROLLCALL presence-proof publisher status for this hub: the epoch it last worked, whether it signed, how many signatures it holds and how many are already on chain, the elected leader and this hub's rank, any txids it published, and whether its signer module can broadcast. Publisher state only: the authoritative roll-call record lives on the BTC indexer.
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: getoraclepublisherstatus
methods.summary: ORACLE (PRICE v0) publisher status: queue depth, lifetime published/abandoned (dead-letter) counts, last-published round + txid, and the last-observed DOGE publisher wallet balance for runway monitoring.

methods.name: getstakeshare
methods.summary: Operator stake share against the STAKE_WEIGHTED_QUORUM commit gate, per chain and capability: total active stake, our share of it, whether it clears 3*tally > 2*S, and how much further third-party stake fits before it stops clearing.

methods.name: geteffectorspendstatus
methods.summary: Effector-spend policy status: each on-chain effector (oracle-publish, attest, anchor, full-node) with its runtime pause state, balance floor, and rolling per-window spend ceiling clamped at the $2000 AML admission ceiling.

methods.name: pauseeffectorspend
methods.summary: Runtime pause of one effector's on-chain spend by capability label (halts its primary/leader path immediately, no restart).
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: resumeeffectorspend
methods.summary: Resume a paused effector's on-chain spend by capability label.
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: propose
methods.summary: Submit a governance proposal over one parameter.
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: proposeslashpenalty
methods.summary: Create a SLASH_PENALTY governance proposal over a validator's pending slash_proposals evidence; a passed vote executes the penalty (suspend or dismiss).
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: getslashproposals
methods.summary: List recorded slash proposals (all statuses), optionally filtered by status and/or validator pubkey. Rows with status "pending" are UNADJUDICATED accusations recorded as evidence, not findings of guilt; enforcement happens only through a passed SLASH_PENALTY governance vote. The verbatim evidence blob is never served: each row carries evidence_hash, the SHA-256 of the stored evidence text, which is the same digest the SLASH_PENALTY evidence hash is built from.

methods.name: vote
methods.summary: Vote on a governance proposal.
methods.x-auth: x-api-key header, when HUB_API_KEY is configured

methods.name: getproposals
methods.summary: List governance proposals, optionally filtered by status and/or parameter name.

methods.name: getproposal
methods.summary: One governance proposal with votes.

methods.name: getvotes
methods.summary: List individual governance votes by proposal and/or voter.

methods.name: getvalidatorcapabilities

methods.name: getattestation
